items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: Well we had been downstairs all of us in Otto and Sonny's room having a ball.

ctx.x: The time you surprised Johnny Hodges in Chicago.
Oh yes. Well we had been downstairs all of us in Otto and Sonny's room having a ball. Drinking. Having a good time Zutty

and I and oh some of the other musicians. Because Sonny Greer and Otto, as soon as they would come in an hotel, they'd put red lights in their room. And the socket on the floor and fix it, oh they'd fix it up. And that was the room to ball in. And we had been up there drinking and having a ball.
